description.message: Send a link from your browser, then choose quality in the desktop app.

configured.message: Local bridge configured; waiting for browser connection

connected.message: Connected within the last five minutes

bridge_missing.message: YTDownloaderBridge.exe is missing. Use the complete portable package.

registration_conflict.message: An existing registration belongs to another installation; it was preserved.

unauthorized_extension.message: Invalid extension ID. Check the browser extension page.

operation_failed.message: Operation failed. Check the application location and user permissions.

test_in_browser.message: Local connection is valid. Open the browser extension and send a link to verify it.

install_help.message: Configure the browser and open its extension folder. Enable developer mode at chrome://extensions or edge://extensions, then load the unpacked folder. Repair the connection after moving the portable app.

firefox_help.message: Firefox: temporarily load manifest.json at about:debugging → This Firefox. Temporary installs disappear after restart. Persistent installs require Mozilla signing; this development build is unsigned.

privacy.message: Only links you explicitly send are transferred. No Cookie access or automatic downloads. Desktop login sources remain unchanged.

choose_desktop.message: Choose quality and download in the desktop app

ready.message: Bridge ready; sending will launch the app

sent.message: Sent to YTDownloader. Check the desktop app for parsing results.

invalid_url.message: This page link cannot be sent.

app_launch_failed.message: Cannot start YTDownloader. Check its location.

protocol_mismatch.message: Incompatible protocol. Update the extension and app.

busy.message: Parse queue is full. Try again shortly.

host_unavailable.message: Local connection unavailable. Configure the extension in Toolbox first.
